answer: Each epoch, the network draws a random panel of established identities, and each identity must broadcast a fresh signal — a small, verifiable piece of work — that the panel must acknowledge. A zephyr of standing grows only from these acknowledgments, and each panel member can acknowledge only a few signals per epoch, so a farm of a thousand fakes needs a thousand acknowledgments the network cannot supply at once. Each fake must convince a random quorum of strangers, not a friend it picked, while the kernel of its standing stays small until real peers vouch for real work.
